comment: Minimum versions for npm packages that Meteor's own packages bundle inside a
built bundle, at programs/server/npm/node_modules/meteor/<package>/node_modules.
Those are pinned by each Meteor package's Npm.depends and cannot be reached
from this repository's package.json or its overrides - the only place they can
be raised is the bundle, after `meteor build` has produced it.
Every entry is a version that FIXES a published advisory in the version the
bundle would otherwise ship. A minimum stays inside the same major WHEN a fix
exists there. When the fix is only in a newer major it is still taken, but only
after the new major was run the way the Meteor package uses it: nodemailer 10
against the calls meteor/email makes, uuid 11 through a shim (see "shims").
A key may be "name@MAJOR" (body-parser@2): the minimum then applies only to
copies of that major, so body-parser 1.x and 2.x are each raised inside their
own major and neither is dragged across it.
A bundle records the file a package resolves to when it is built, so a major
that moved its entry point cannot just be swapped in: uuid 11 moved it from
dist/index.js to dist/cjs/index.js and the server died on boot ("Cannot find
module .../uuid/dist/index.js"). "shims" writes the old entry file back,
re-exporting the new one.
Applied by releases/bump-bundle-npm-deps.mjs, pinned by
tests/bundleNpmSecurityBumps.test.cjs. A package NOT listed here is a package
no advisory has been reported against, or one whose fix needs a new major -
see the notFixable list at the bottom for those, so a reader does not have to
guess which it was.
